verdict.rationale: Asking for a machine-readable API spec is fair for a cloud communications SDK and service, so the axis applies. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and nothing in the pack documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The llms.txt and Markdown documentation pages are AI-friendly docs, not API specifications, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
